description: This file defines a utility support for browser discovery of network services using Apple's Network framework. It provides a method to create and configure an NWBrowser for Bonjour service discovery, handling state updates and results asynchronously with proper thread context.

methods.name: makeBrowser
methods.description: Creates and configures an NWBrowser to discover network services of a specified type and domain, with callbacks for state changes and results. It sets up the necessary parameters, handlers, and starts the browser on a specified dispatch queue.
